headline: Action Items, from entry to detail
overview: Action Items is your unified task hub, aggregating all action items generated across the app — from meeting follow-ups and coaching homework to breakthrough commitments. Instead of scattered to-dos buried inside individual modules, everything you've committed to doing appears in one place, linked back to its source so you can always see the context behind each task.
targetAudience: Users interested in growth tools for personal growth and self-discovery.

steps.title: Action Items — Landing State
steps.description: The landing page showing the initial state and main interface, with the unified list of action items from meetings, coaching, and breakthroughs.

keyFeatures: Unified view of all action items from meetings, coaching, and breakthrough modules
Filter and sort by source, status, or due date
Mark items complete and track overall accountability progress
Direct links to the source meeting, session, or breakthrough for full context
tips: Review your Action Items list at the start of each week to plan your priorities
Use the source links to revisit the full context before working on a task
note: Imported from Inner Quest's app-owned walkthrough library. The captures are real product evidence, but their original run manifest and detailed interaction log predate Walkthrough Studio, so freshness is not claimed.
